instruction: The warehouse order system loses track of stock. After sequences of placing, cancelling and shipping orders, available counts drift away from what was received, orders interfere with each other, a rejected order can leave stock reserved, and the dict an Inventory was created from changes behind its owner's back. tests/test_orders.py fails. Make inventory.py and orders.py honour the contracts in their docstrings. Keep the public classes, methods and signatures unchanged, change only those two files, and don't modify the tests.
